{P : Measure Ω} {B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ} (hB : IsBrownianReal B P)
    (hm : ∀ t, Measurable (B t)) (hBm : Measurable (Function.uncurry B))
    (hBc : ∀ ω, Continuous (fun t => B t ω)) (hB0 : ∀ ω, B 0 ω = 0)
    (κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hκ8 : κ < 8)
findings.problem: The monotonicity conclusion is bundled with stopping-time regularity under Brownian assumptions and 0 < κ < 8, although it holds for any continuous capacity-two driver. This matters within this file: actual_phase_regulator and actual_phase_switch_clock require horder but do not require κ < 8. Their ordering hypothesis should be obtainable without introducing that restriction or a Brownian measure.
findings.benefit: Makes the ordering result directly reusable for deterministic Loewner drivers and for the pathwise phase identities when κ ≥ 8, while preserving the existing stochastic interface.
